latest.headline: scagliox01 Claims Dominant Victory in Sweden
latest.paragraph: scagliox01 secured a commanding victory at the Sweden rally, finishing the ten-stage event with a total time of 00:45:30.821. Dominating the field with three stage wins, scagliox01 accrued 39 points in total, including 4 points from the final power stage. E69Korrea maintained consistency to secure second place, while volos72 rounded out the podium. Despite volos72 taking the maximum 5 points on the power stage, scagliox01 held a clear advantage throughout the weekend. The rally saw 30 entries, with novagsi20 being the only driver recorded with a DNF during the event.
